name: Large-sale impact decay
hypothesis: Buy the recovery high after comparable-size sales show declining realized impact and independent buying resumes.
spec: Setup: Repeated sales moving price less may indicate improving absorption. Entry: Buy the recovery high after comparable-size sales show declining realized impact and independent buying resumes. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit when sale impact expands or the recovery low fails. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs swap-level flow and trade-size cohorts over time (not connected)
